facts.summary: Phase 3 missed clinical co-primary endpoint, extension studies discontinued, 49% layoffs · Phase 3 · latozinemab in FTD-GRN · not yet approved
facts.indication: frontotemporal dementia due to a GRN mutation

evidence.summary: latozinemab, developed in collaboration with GSK, did not meet the clinical co-primary endpoint of slowing FTD-GRN progression
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: did not meet the clinical co-primary endpoint of slowing FTD-GRN progression, as measured by the Clinical Dementia Rating® plus National Alzheimer’s Coordinating Center Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration Sum of Boxes
evidence.safety: Preliminary safety data have not highlighted any major safety concerns at present.
evidence.program_discontinued: the open-label extension portion of the INFRONT-3 trial and the continuation study for latozinemab will be discontinued.
